purpose: Teach: 通りすがり/引っかかっ/見逃す/警部/一目瞭然/閉ざさ/見抜く/難題

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 通りすがりの来客、応対、丁寧にしろ。
lines.en: Visitors passing through — handle them with care and respect.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. Each phrase lands with weight. No warmth, no pause. The tone of someone who expects compliance and gets it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。問題、契約書に引っかかった箇所、整理しました。
lines.en: Understood. I've organized the contract issues and the problem areas.
lines.style: Steady, professional delivery. Matter-of-fact precision. Slight lean forward — showing readiness. Confidence without flourish.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 危険を見逃すな、警備、徹底しろ。
lines.en: Don't overlook risks. Security needs to be airtight.
lines.style: Firm, direct. Each word deliberate. A light stress on 'airtight' — non-negotiable. The voice of someone used to being heard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警部級の専門家と、連携を深めています。
lines.en: I'm deepening our coordination with inspector-level specialists now.
lines.style: Clear, measured. Showing progress without over-stating. Respectful pace — not rushing, not lagging. The tone of someone reporting upward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 目的、一目瞭然のプレゼン、用意しろ。
lines.en: Make sure the presentation is crystal clear. The objective needs to be unmissable.
lines.style: Direct instruction. Slightly faster pace on the second half — urgency without harshness. The cadence of a senior laying out expectations.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。閉ざされたデータ、開放への動き、進めます。
lines.en: Understood. I'm moving forward on opening up the restricted data.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Steady tempo. A small note of resolve in 'opening up' — this matters. Not defensive, just firm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 本質を見抜く判断、信頼の核だ。
lines.en: Sound judgment about what's real — that's the foundation of trust.
lines.style: Slower, reflective. Each phrase allowed to breathe. The tone of someone offering something that took experience to learn. Measured, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。残された難題、若手と共に取り組みます。
lines.en: Understood. I'll work through the remaining challenges with the junior team.
lines.style: Closing note — respectful, steady. Quiet conviction about the path forward. Not rushed. The tone of someone ready to carry the load.
